formulas.MUTABLE_LOCAL_BACKUP_PEAK: ZIP_STORED retain-1 of 97d operational sqlite (bodies removed) + paper + operational_state + WAL
formulas.UNARCHIVED_TAIL_DURABILITY_BYTES: 24h RPO copy of not-yet-Drive-verified HOT parquet+raw (one selected day)
formulas.STAGING_PEAK: P_stage = one selected-architecture day while packaging

measured_denominators.scientific_span_source: parquet first_reliable_available_at min/max on live observation_rdp
measured_denominators.limitation: LIVE cohort is ~3 days, not 90. Linear 97d assumes mix stays similar. Do not use 14:17Z-to-19:23Z catch-up (+229 MiB RDP in ~5.1h) as typical. Do not use 2026-09-04 as a healthy UTC day (HOST_UNREACHABLE/reboot).

R_day.basis: call_ledger $.rows json 60899842 / raw_span_days; unique response_sha extra bytes only 387031
R_day.poll_slots: NOT added as extra unique raw; see poll_slots_overlap

M_day.basis: sqlite file minus call+poll payload_json = 58565148 / raw_span_days; research journals counted inside S_day

A_layout.basis: members SNAPPY->ZSTD3 median 1607686/2167088; HOT raw JSON->ZSTD3 parquet 597114/3909820 on 80-row sample; metadata 1.0

same_volume.note: Other-device sink may be excluded only after machine proof. Current git-side sink is same st_dev.

poll_slots_overlap.note: Every poll_slots payload_json has an exact sha256 match in call_ledger. Same JSON shape was insufficient; exact payload hash overlap is the proof. The one response_sha256 miss carries 2 rows-json bytes.

publication_rate.stress_basis: max completed-job count on a full UTC day excluding the outage/reboot day
publication_rate.variance_note: 121 vs 258 on consecutive full UTC days; dimension is BOUNDED not a 90d-stable rate

mutable_backup_basis.scale: 97 / raw_span_days after removing call+poll payload_json from current sqlite file

conservative_measured_stress.basis: stress_publications_per_day 258 times members p95/mean bytes/publication after ZSTD3, plus freq-scaled raw+metadata, plus freq-scaled mutable backup, plus 24h tail copy, plus staging

current_topology_contrast_not_selected.note: Recursive ZIP_STORED of full observation_rdp on same volume remains REJECT as HOT data plane. Mutable retain-1 snapshot is still same-volume and is now an explicit additive term, not B_same_vol=1.0 with zero backup bytes.

contractual_not_measured.note: Do not call this a measured run-rate. It already exceeds HARD 50 GiB. Admission must not treat the cap as expected fill. Not used as publication rate.
